title: fix(service-datasource, rest): the datasource Sync doors and federation twins answer an unknown name 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27618

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the kind is `none` and there is no narrowing arm; no `skills/**` or `content/docs` page states what these doors answer for an unknown datasource name (`git grep` for `remote-tables`, `object-draft`, `refresh-catalog`, `has no datasource definition` outside the release notes: no such sentence).

Claim: 6504788091 (seat `domain:server#2`, branch `claude/project-thread-bvrf7w`, the card thread's harness-pinned branch). Triage direction: 6500612695. Ruling: none.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据源的「同步」入口（列远端表、生成对象草稿）以及 `/external/` 下的四个联邦入口（列表、草稿、导入、刷新目录），对一个根本不存在的数据源名，现在统一回 `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`，措辞与 `GET /datasources/NAME` 完全一致；包内「数据源不存在」的报错收成一个共用函数。
- **为什么改**：之前这些入口对不存在的名字回 `400`，还附一段「请把数据源声明为 external」的说教，管理工具、脚本和 AI 调用方会误以为是请求写错了，而其它按名入口早已回 404。
- **风险与回滚**：只改错误状态码与文案，正常路径不动；已存在但不是联邦源的数据源（托管的、主数据源）仍回原来的 400。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/external-datasource-service.ts`（`assertFederationSource` 新增的「无定义」分支）、`packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts`（`answerThrown` 的 404 透传）、`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts`（唯一的 `datasourceNotFoundError`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/external-datasource-unknown-name.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全绿（4 个入口回 404，8 个对照仍回 400）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ExternalDatasourceService.assertFederationSource` (the guard every federation door runs first) now splits the two cases it folded together: a name with **no datasource definition** throws the 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` envelope (`Datasource "NAME" does not exist.`), and a definition that is **not a federation source** keeps its `400` with the door's code (`EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR`, or `EXTERNAL_IMPORT_ERROR` for the import). The primary datasource is still refused first, by name, with its own `400`. `notAFederationSourceError` no longer takes an absent definition, so its dead "has no datasource definition" arm is gone.
- **One helper, not copies.** The two private `datasourceNotFoundError` copies (admin service, external service) are merged into one in `datasource-admin-service.ts`, exported from that module for its siblings only. ⛔ It is not added to the package index (`src/index.ts` uses named exports only and is unchanged), so the published surface does not move. `GET /datasources/NAME` in `admin-routes.ts` now takes its 404 words from the same helper, so every by-name door spells the answer once.
- `service-datasource`'s admin routes already relayed that envelope as 404 (`badRequest`), so `GET …/remote-tables` and `POST …/object-draft` needed no route change, only the guard.
- `packages/rest`'s federation family answered every non-fault throw `400`. `answerThrown` now relays the 404 / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` envelope as such (both fields required, as in `badRequest`), so `GET …/external/tables`, `POST …/external/tables/REMOTE/draft`, `POST …/external/tables/REMOTE/import` and `POST …/external/refresh-catalog` answer an unknown name as `GET /datasources/NAME` does. Every other throw keeps this family's `400` and code.

## Tests

- New `service-datasource/src/__tests__/federation-doors-unknown-name.test.ts`, over the real composition (real `ObjectQL`, connection service, admin service, `ExternalDatasourceServicePlugin` wiring, admin routes on Hono, an entitled caller): `GET /datasources/no_such_ds/remote-tables` and `POST /datasources/no_such_ds/object-draft` answer status, code and message **equal to** `GET /datasources/no_such_ds` (404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`); controls: a managed datasource and the primary datasource still answer `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` with their reasons.
- New `rest/src/external-datasource-unknown-name.test.ts`, the real service under the real routes on Hono: the four `/external/` twins answer `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `Datasource "no_such_ds" does not exist.` (GET's words); controls: managed and primary datasources still answer `400` with each door's own code.
- Moved pins (they held the folded answer this card reverses): `managed-datasource-sync-refusal.test.ts` (the `ghost` case now expects the 404) and `external-metadata-read-at-use.test.ts` (the no-metadata-service case now expects the 404 envelope from all four service methods).
- Red first: before the fix, the 2 new `service-datasource` 404 pins and the 4 new `rest` 404 pins were red (`400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` / `EXTERNAL_IMPORT_ERROR`, "has no datasource definition …"), the controls green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ablation, two legs, each red then restored** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first, restore blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). Both suites read source (`service-datasource` tests import `src/` directly; `rest`'s `vitest.config.ts` aliases `@objectstack/service-datasource` to its `src/index.ts`), so no `dist/` rebuild is in either leg.
  - Leg 1, delete `if (!ds) throw datasourceNotFoundError(datasource);` in `assertFederationSource`: `service-datasource` 2 failed / 4 passed, `rest` 4 failed / 8 passed (every 404 pin red, every 400 control green). Restored blob `922e07c2df3d` == HEAD.
  - Leg 2, delete the 404 relay in `rest`'s `answerThrown`: `rest` 4 failed / 8 passed, received `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` / `400 EXTERNAL_IMPORT_ERROR`. Restored blob `1629a50c6b7e` == HEAD.
- A deployment with **no metadata service at all** cannot read any datasource definition, so these doors now answer such a name 404 where they answered the "no definition" 400. That is the reading `POST /datasources/NAME/test` already makes since #27574 (it resolves through the same `getDatasource` read), so the by-name doors stay one answer; noted, not a change of direction.
- Observation, not filed: `POST /datasources/NAME/external/validate` does not run the federation guard (it lists the federated objects bound to NAME), so an unknown name answers `200` with an empty report. That is code reading only (no door measured), outside this card's doors.
- Branch name is the card thread's harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-bvrf7w`, not the `claude/issue-N-slug` convention; the claim above is its identity record.
